fluid.body: A stable-fluids solver: advection, vorticity confinement and 20 Jacobi pressure iterations per frame, with dye drawn as halftone. Hover for ink; hold the button or Shift for red pencil.

rd.title: Reaction–diffusion
rd.body: Gray–Scott: A is fed in, B eats A and decays. Nudge two numbers and the growth turns from coral to mazes, spots or waves. 14 iterations per frame.
